weakest_link: Idea 1 depends on finding sheltered backwaters at tributary mouths that are at least 3.7 m deep at end-of-winter low stage, where a loaded barge can freeze in without grounding and survive break-up. Its novelty is also weak, because loaded vessels may already be wintered this way.
flip_test: Survey the candidate tributary mouths for end-of-April depth, and pull the historical loss and damage rates for vessels wintered there. The ranking flips in either of two cases:
unknown: Even if Idea 1 works, nobody knows how many tributaries depend on the flood crest alone and carry enough cargo for a saving of about 1.5–3.6x on one leg to matter in the full delivered cost. The total may be a small, niche saving rather than a change in how these resources reach market.
